correctness.rationale: Rank-one trace factorization and RB bilinearity produce the exact eigenvalue conditions AB=cB, BA=dB with c+d=mu; the polynomial t(t-mu) forces the two exclusive cases in every characteristic. Square-zero matrix counting and idempotent-space complement counting yield the two q-sums with correct projective normalization. Direct basis-identity checks exhaust all rank-one maps over M2(F2), M2(F3); all tensor representatives over M3(F2) satisfy the predicted counts. The proof, not the finite tests, establishes all dimensions.

value.rationale: The complete one-dimensional-image locus is a natural first nontrivial stratum of Rota–Baxter operators on a central simple algebra. The theorem gives an intrinsic square-zero versus idempotent-image dichotomy, handles all characteristics, and counts every labeled operator for every matrix size over every finite field. It resolves a natural global counting invariant not furnished by low-order conjugacy classifications. No larger operator classification is asserted.
